item.tib: rnam dag dri med spyi bshags sprul sku khyung rgod rtsal gyi gter ma
item.coloph: rnam dag dri med mchog byang spyi bshags zhes bya ba/ 'phrin las thams cad kyi sngon 'gro/ them byang bshags pa'i yig chung / sprul sku khyung rgod rtsal la/ 'a zha bdag gis zhus/ 'di shog dril zhing du chag gang dkyus mtho do sor bzhi/ yig 'phreng brgyad (brgya) dang bdun bcu don gnyis la zhal bshus so//
